title: devices/{k}/ota/progress
description: RodakOS emission profile; the invalid fixture is a RodakOS-profile negative. Rodak requires a nonblank taskNo of an owned task, coerces progressPercent with Number() (non-finite -> 0, no range clamp), keeps stepCode only as a trimmed nonblank string, drops detail on MQTT, and ignores protocolVersion. Progress never completes a task; only the HTTP result does.
